title: phlox subulata subsp. brittonii
intro: Phlox subulata subsp. brittonii, commonly known as Britton's phlox or creeping phlox, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Polemoniaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Britton's phlox include its sedative and calming effects, which can aid in reducing anxiety and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
